description.value: Inn on the Harbour is a boutique hotel perched on a bluff overlooking the busy Prince Rupert harbour, with recently renovated rooms and a patio lounge facing the water. It sits at a major transportation crossroads for BC Ferries, Alaska Ferries, VIA Rail, and air connections, making it a natural base for touring cyclists arriving or departing by ferry or train. Rotary Waterfront Park is on the doorstep and downtown shopping and services are within walking distance.

address.value: 720 1st Avenue West, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 3V6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed information about the hotel. Continental breakfast (included with all bookings) and Wi-Fi are explicitly confirmed on the front page, and OSM's internet_access=wlan corroborates the Wi-Fi claim. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site, so those remain null. Contact details on the website (720 First Avenue West, 1-250-624-9107) match OSM tags.
concerns: Website contact page lists two additional phone numbers (1-800-663-8155 toll-free and 1-250-627-8232) not present in the OSM record; OSM only carries the local number +1-250-624-9107.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active boutique hotel with a functioning website and booking system, ideally situated near Prince Rupert ferry and rail terminals — directly useful to touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: major transportation crossroads for BC Ferries, Alaska Ferries, VIA Rail, and air connections... Continental breakfast included with all bookings

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: renovated boutique harbour-view inn with breakfast, Prince Rupert; $150-190
